title: Visa Estimated and Incremental Authorization Transactions
applicability: Visa estimated/initial and incremental authorizations for permitted merchants. MCC 4121/5411 require card-not-present context; MCC 5552 requires EV context. These listed restrictions are not an exhaustive permitted-merchant list: Appendix AE also addresses lodging, cruise and rental merchants.

businessRequirements.title: For permitted merchants, MCC 4121/5411 estimated and incremental authorizations require card-not-present context; MCC 5552 requires EV context. Other MCC eligibility is not established by these three restrictions.
An estimated/initial authorization request for a permitted merchant shall include the estimated authorization indicator (Acquirer Trace Data Sub Table ID 09) when the final amount is unknown.

An incremental authorization request shall follow an estimated/initial authorization, must not resend the estimated-authorization indicator, and must carry the same Sequence Number, Transaction Identifier, and Terminal Transaction Number (Segment 111 Table ID 63) as the original estimated/initial request.

Estimated and subsequent incremental approvals expire from the initial estimate after 14 days for cruise/lodging/car or vehicle rental, or seven days for other rental merchants. For longer stays or rentals, complete the first transaction and initiate the second on or before day 14 or day seven, as applicable.

testCases.positive: Permitted-merchant evidence plus card-not-present for MCC 4121/5411 or EV for MCC 5552
Initial request includes the estimated-authorization indicator when amount is unknown
negative: Indicator omitted on an eligible estimated request

testCases.positive: Incremental request preserves Sequence Number/Transaction Identifier/Table ID 63 and omits the estimated indicator; completion within the 7/14-day window
negative: Incremental request without a preceding estimated/initial authorization
Sequence Number or Terminal Transaction Number mismatch
estimated indicator resent on incremental request
completion outside the applicable expiration window
